mechanism: Disulfiram inhibits CYP2D6 and CYP3A4, increasing fluphenazine plasma concentrations and risk of antipsychotic toxicity; both drugs increase CNS depression and have anticholinergic effects.
action: Monitor for increased extrapyramidal symptoms, sedation, and anticholinergic effects; consider fluphenazine dose reduction or use alternative antipsychotic metabolized differently.
